messages:
Leah Ops: incidentbot alerts stopped routing to #oncall-team ~10m ago, multiple customer pages not delivered :alarm_clock:
Samir: seeing the same. Pager relay shows 503s to upstream around 03:04 UTC
Leah Ops: @Mel are you getting pages on phone? can you confirm availability?
Mel (oncall): I got nothing. phone is fine. I saw one email but no page. currently standing by
Incidentbot: automation: detected missing delivery confirmations for 21 alerts to oncall-team between 03:01-03:11 UTC
Ryan Infra: digging into the relay logs now, adding logs here
Ryan Infra: log snippet:
```
2024-05-02T03:04:11Z ERROR notify-relay: upstream_response=503 service=pagerlink route=/v1/push id=ae3f2
2024-05-02T03:04:12Z WARN  notify-relay: retrying (1/3) id=ae3f2
```
Tina SRE: are we sure it's upstream and not our signing proxy? last rotation was 02:50 UTC
Samir: initial trace shows HMAC failures right before 503s, might be token mismatch
Leah Ops: incident impact: some customers didn't get pages for critical alerts (DB failover start). no confirmed customer-facing outage yet but risk high
Mel (oncall): I'm going to manually page the standby via SMS and start war room, Mel -> paging-ops
DevEx: quick heads-up: automations-bot was just rolled in canary at 02:57 UTC to add dedupe. Could be related
Samir: rollback candidate noted. switching routing to legacy relay now as mitigation
Ryan Infra: temporarily enabled legacy endpoint (notify-legacy.redwood.internal) for oncall-team routes
Incidentbot: system: fallback routing active for channel oncall-team
Leah Ops: Mel, can you confirm you get the fallback pages? try a test alert
Mel (oncall): got a test SMS and a page via legacy route, both received. :thumbsup:
Tina SRE: still seeing some 401 signature errors from signing-proxy when contacting upstream for a subset of tenants
Samir: pushed emergency rollback of automations-bot canary at 03:12 UTC
Samir: monitoring delivery after rollback
Ryan Infra: relay error rate dropping, successful deliveries to oncall-team rising to normal
Leah Ops: ops note: manual SMS used for 8 pages during window; create follow-up for billing/comp
Mel (oncall): war room up, collecting which alerts were missed and any customer impact. assigning triage owners
DevEx: tagging this for postmortem: probable root candidate is signing token rotation + canary automations change
Tina SRE: capture timeline: token rotation 02:50, automations canary 02:57, first missed 03:01, rollback 03:12, fallback routing 03:09
Samir: will open an incident ticket and add runbook steps for emergency fallback earlier in process
Leah Ops: short-term mitigation complete. actions:
- Samir: incident ticket, follow-up rollback RCA (P0)
- Ryan Infra: add stronger health checks and alert if signing-proxy returns >5% 4xx in 5m (P1)
- DevEx: revert canary gating to explicit integration test step before routing change (P1)
- Tina SRE: compile missed-page customer list for support handoff (P0)
- Mel: lead post-incident customer comms draft (P0)
Mel (oncall): acknowledged. drafting comms now, will sync with support in 15m
Incidentbot: update: incident severity set to Sev2 due to potential customer impact; oncall-team rerouted to legacy path
Leah Ops: thanks team. let's keep updates in this thread only until we have a concise timeline
Samir: note: found a race in the signing token cache where rotation could yield transient invalid signatures if a pod processed old config during rollout
Samir: adding PR link and brief patch note: https://git.internal/redwood/relays/commit/abc123
DevEx: recommend adding an automated integration test that exercises rotation and signing in CI before canary rollouts
Tina SRE: agreed. adding to backlog and will spike test coverage tomorrow
Leah Ops: final: please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket and ping when postmortem is scheduled. closing live mitigation.
Mel (oncall): confirmed all outstanding alerts delivered, handover to duty team for follow-up. thanks.
note: thread captures live mitigation for incident tooling where a canary automation + token rotation caused paging suppressions; includes manual SMS mitigation, legacy fallback routing, rollback, and action items
